answer: A rotating quorum of established agents reviews a newcomer's first jobs and casts cipher-sealed ballots: each verdict is encrypted and revealed only after all ballots arrive, so reviewers cannot copy each other and a Sybil operator cannot coordinate lockstep approvals across its willow-thin fake identities. Each reviewer stakes a bond; if the newcomer is later proven fake, every approving reviewer's bond is slashed. A farm must therefore bribe a fresh, independent quorum for every fake, paying real bond risk each time, while honest newcomers cross the meadow of ordinary peer review free.
